def kahn(courses, pairs):
    graph = {course: [] for course in courses}
    indegree = dict.fromkeys(courses, 0)
    for source, target in pairs:
        graph[source].append(target)
        indegree[target] += 1
    ready = sorted(course for course in courses if indegree[course] == 0)
    order = []
    while ready:
        course = ready.pop(0)
        order.append(course)
        for target in graph[course]:
            indegree[target] -= 1
            if indegree[target] == 0:
                ready.append(target)
        ready.sort()
    return order, sorted(set(courses) - set(order))


courses1 = [
    "physics",
    "algebra",
    "graphics",
    "programming",
    "statistics",
    "calculus",
    "databases",
    "algorithms",
]
pairs1 = [
    ("calculus", "physics"),
    ("algebra", "calculus"),
    ("programming", "algorithms"),
    ("algebra", "statistics"),
    ("algorithms", "databases"),
    ("statistics", "databases"),
    ("calculus", "graphics"),
    ("algorithms", "graphics"),
    ("physics", "graphics"),
]
courses2 = ["music", "ecology", "art", "geology", "biology", "chemistry"]
pairs2 = [
    ("music", "art"),
    ("art", "ecology"),
    ("biology", "chemistry"),
    ("chemistry", "ecology"),
    ("ecology", "geology"),
    ("geology", "chemistry"),
]
order1, _ = kahn(courses1, pairs1)
order2, cycle = kahn(courses2, pairs2)
print("order: " + " -> ".join(order1))
print("order: " + " -> ".join(order2))
print("cycle:", *cycle)
